tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /(kha shog mi gsal kyang drug cu ma'i skor dogs dri zhig 'dra/)oṃ swasti/ gangs ljongs 'di na sa skya pa'i/ /lugs 'dir bstan pa'i bdag po zhes/ /rang gis tshig gcig ma bsgrags kyang / /nyi shar sbar mos mi khebs zhes/ /gna' bo'i rgan gtam de re bden/ /'dzam gling kun na dri bzhon ltar/ /snyan grags gsal ldan bstan srung mchog /gur mgon mnga' bdag sa lo che/ /min zhes shes ldan su smra nus/ /de'i mgon po'i shog dril drug /gter ma'i ya gyal drug cu pa'i/ /man ngag gab gsal mdzad pa la/ /tshad ldan yi ge gang la brten/ /zhes pa'i dogs slong 'di ci zhig /'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba/ /tshad ldan min na de'i rjes 'jug /tshad ldan yin gsung bka' min nam/ /shangs tsor phyag mdzub tshugs zhus na/ /sa lo'i tsha gtogs ha cang kyang / /kha 'chal skyon yod bzod par gsol/ /zhes kha 'chal ba khos rang mtshang rjen par bstan nas don la mgon po drug cu pa'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum dag rung ma dag rung / sa lo chen po'i gsung dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri 'di ni rtsa bar 'dzin dgos kyang sbyor ba des 'thus par byas shing / dngos gzhi'i ngag 'don las sa skya lo tsā ba'i dngos dbon sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma'i chos srid snyigs dus spel bstan la 'gran bral de 'dra la'ang gzhan nas dga' sdug sna tshogs byed 'dug pas 'phags pa'i mdzad pa dang po skye ba'i snang tshul la ci yod ces zom me bzhag na sdig pa mi gsog pa tsam rgyu mtshan du byas nas sngags 'chang de nyid kyi phyag len zhib cha'i mchan bkod dang / dpal sa skya rang du gtong tshul gyi deb phyag dreg 'byar ba'ang yod/ rigs sras grags pa'i mtshan can gyi lhan thabs dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi dris lan log rtogs 'joms pa'i lha dbang rdo rje na/ dam pa kun dga' grags kyi yig rnying khungs su drangs pa'i legs bshad mkhas pas rgol bar bral ba yod pas sku drin la tshad med/

'on kyang sa skya pa kun blo rang ni tshad ldan yi ge gang la brten/ de dang mthun pa'i phyag len yod lags sam gsung ba 'di la lan 'di skad zhu ste/ tshad ldan yi ge sa lo'i gsung la brten/ /de dang mthun pa'i phyag len mgon des mdzad/ /zhus na dam pa kun dga' grags kyi yig rnying rang mi dgos 'dra/ gang ltar cho lo smra ba sa smyon ko chag pa'i tsha bo kun blo kho rang gi lugs yin pas bzang ngan gang du'ang ma sems shig dgos don snying po rang 'di nas yin pas nyon ang / thog mar sngon 'gro gtor sngags/ oṃ sarba sogs la mchog sbyin phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtogs pa tshar gsum yin/ de nas rnga brdungs nas gang zhig 'byung po nas/ gzhan du dengs bar/ 'das dang ma byon ma zhes rgyud tshig mgon bskul de la bla ma gong ma'i gsung gdangs yod kyang yi ge lag nas 'dri shes pas gsung rgyun ngag la ltos dgos/ rol mo ni sbraṃ sbraṃ zhes pa'i dang po bcol dang / gnyis pa len yin pas bcol len zer/ de nas gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga drug bdun/ gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga drug bdun/ gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga drug bdun/ gcig de nas je myur la btang ste/ sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha/ oṃ sum bha sogs hūm̐ bzhi ma kun rig srung 'khor skabs/ sogs nas 'byung ba dang / oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sogs shā sa na sa lo'i zhu dag ni sgra gzhung gi mtshams sbyor dang mthun/ hūm̐ hūm̐ yod pa 'di nged rang la ni nus pa che nges myong ba zhig byung / u pa hā ri sogs rgyud dang gong ma'i gsung sor bzhag yin pas gang byas kyang 'dra yong / rol mo je myur de la chem rdung zer/ snga mo gshog pa chig rdeb rang yin/ deng sang phan tshun rdeb pa 'di su'i thog la byung ni rgyus med/ je myur la'ang mi gtong bar glo bur myur ba 'di ni mgyogs jus rang yin 'dra yang rang re slob dpon bzang dregs slob phrug rbab shor 'di las med dkar dung sgang dung zhes thos brgyud ltar yin/

chems brdungs rdzogs nas sbraṃ sbraṃ/ gcig gnyis gsum byas/ gcig gnyis gsum byas/ zer mkhan 'di rigs la gsum rdeb len can zer/ de rdzogs nas rnga rol bzhag gnas yo byin rlabs dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi gzhung ltar mdzad/ rang gi bsam tshod la ni/ bdag bskyed kye rdor lam dus mdzad na kye rdor gnas yo byin rlabs kyis kyang chog bsam rung / phyag len gong bzhin yin pas/ dharma ra ṇi'i dung la mi mdzad/ skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar lam dus rgyas 'bring gang rung byas kyang chog brag rdzong las kyang los 'thus kyang / phyag len la lam dus rgyas pa dang brag rdzong ma byas na yi ge bcu gnyis ma dang bdun ma shib bu phreng 'khor/ shā sa na shib bu rgyun bzhin phreng 'khor gyi phyed sleb pa dang 'ur 'don byas nas phyed po de la byed ma kha kha nas/ byad ma de na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces spel tshig sbyor byed ma zhes pa spyi tshig yin pas phan thogs byed ma/ gnod pa byed ma btang snyoms byed ma gsum gar los 'jug 'du shes kyi dbang gis da lam byed ma ni bstan bshig byed ma rbod gtor dug sbyor/ dmag jag sogs mi 'tshams pa byed ma'am gzugs med nag phyogs pa rnams kyis gdug rtsub dngos shugs gang byed ma rnams yin/ ma zhes sbyor dgos pa ni/ ma gzhi rang nas zhes phal skad la grags pa ltar gnod pa'i gzhi la rang yin pas tshig sdud byas nas byed ma kha kha sogs yin kyang 'greng bu med pa'i byad ma bris pa mang bas byad dang sbyor rtsub lta bu la'ang 'jug gang yang mi shes pa rnams des la zhib lta mi byed par bye ma kha kha zer mkhan yang 'dug pas/ ci yang med pa'i bsgom chen gyis/ /phyin yang phan gnod gang yang med/ /ces pa'i gras so/ /bha ya na tshar gsum/ dmod pa sogs brag rdzong la sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa srung 'khor bsdus nas gtor bsngo chen mo'i kye rdor bde mchog gtor bsngo rgyun bzhin gur lha brgyad la bzlog dkyil oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs ba sogs drug cu pa'i gzhung bzhin/

zhal nas las mgon rdzogs par gtor bsngo chen mo bzhin/ bran bdud drug cu pa'i gzhung bzhin/ bstod phrin sh+lau ka re la dril gsil re/ dkar bdud nas gzhi bdag gtor bsngo'i bar gtor bsngo chen mo bzhin/ yig brgya sogs sngags grangs drug cu pa'i mchan dang nged rang gi lhan thabs bzhin bzlas mjug mchod pa phrin bcol bshags pa bcas gtor bsngo chen mo bzhin/ bshags pa gcig gam gsum gang byas kyang yong / bskang rdzas byin rlabs drug cu pa'i gzhung na/ bskang gsar dang cung tshig mi 'dra ba yod pa bzhin byed skabs bcom dung gsum thos brgyud bzhin/ rol mo bcom pa zhes/ sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ/ 'phar blangs pa gsum/ chems brdung sbraṃ zhes 'phar chen gcig gnyis gsum rnams 'phar chung yin/ sbraṃ 'phar chen gcig gnyis gsum byas/ gcig gnyis gsum je myur/ chems brdung yin kyang phal cher bzhi byas zer ba mang / rjes ma de'ang gnyis nas je myur byas par go ba mang / chems brdung rdzogs nas sbraṃ sbraṃ/ gcig gnyis byas/ gcig gnyis zhes nyes brdeg len med 'phar chen yin/ de nas swa ring rol mo 'phar chen de la ci yang mi zer/ sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis byas gcig gnyis zhes 'jog bu dbyangs gnyis la 'phar med nyis brdeg hūm̐ chos nyid nas/ mchod pa'i gnas la tshig rol/ tshig rol zer rgyu 'di dus phyis byung phro rang yin 'dug kyang 'di nas byung bshad rgyu mi 'dug rol yig gi dgongs pa ni rnga tshig len pa yin pas/ da lta yul chen ban tshang pa'i 'di yin/ de bzhin tshig rol kun la 'gre/ gzhug nas dgra bgegs la tshig rol lha mo'i spyan 'dren chos dbyings ma dang por phur dbyangs/ de dang gnyis med rol mo sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis byas gcig gnyis gnyis pa'i dbyangs de bas myur tsam rol mo 'dra gsum po de bas kyang myur ba rol mo 'dra/ yab gcig lha chen nas 'dur/ dam nyams sogs tshig dgu la rol mo re/

brtse bar sogs la tshig rol/ lha mchog ma'i dbyangs ring gnyis la nyis brdeg 'phar ma/ myur mgyogs sde brgyad dzar/ gsum brdeg len med/ dam nyams sogs la gong bzhin/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir la tshig rol/ pu tra la dad pa dang ni la gsum brdeg chung bzhi sbraṃ the ba'i dgu brdung yin kyang bcu dkrol ba 'grig de 'phros tshig rkang drug gi dbyangs rol 'dra/ dkar bdud spyan 'dren dbyangs la/ rol mo nyis brdeg len med 'phar ma/ rjes ma'i gnyis nas je myur chems brdung sbraṃ gcig gnyis zer 'jog rgyu yin kyang gcig gnyis gsum byas kyang 'grig mtshan nyid ldan pa'i sogs la hūm̐ bh+yoḥ 'gor yod pa gsung rgyun yin tshig rol chems rdung / sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum byas/ gcig gnyis gsum byas/ gcig rol bskor 'phar 'phros la 'jog par 'bebs zer/ 'bul sngags phyi nang mchod phrin rgyun bzhin/ yig rnying dang dgra bgegs gnad gcod gnyis na mthun par ling chung drug cu rtsa bzhi grangs de mtshungs mtheb skyur bcas la dgug gzhug bya bar gsung yang / phyag len la ling chung drug cu rtsa bzhi la dgug gzhug dkyus bzhin tshar gsum/ lha dbye tshar gcig de nas slob dpon gyi g.yas gri gug g.yon der btags dar nag bzung nas 'chams stangs byed dus phyis g.yon gyi dar nag la ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar byed pa 'di byung phrog yin sngar med/ rol mo ni sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum gyi 'chams tshul ni sbraṃ la mdun du mnan/ sbraṃ la bteg gcig la lag g.yas g.yon du g.yab/ gnyis la lag g.yas 'phyar/ g.yon lte ba'i thad kar gyen bstan/ gsum la lag gnyis g.yas su brkyangs/ de nas gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga drug bdun la yang pad sngon 'gro'i g.yas gnon/ yang pad sngon 'gro'i g.yon gnon/ yang pad sngon 'gro'i dbus gnon/ gcig ces mdun du lag pa bzhag dpang gzugs dang 'das dang ma'i 'dur gdangs gcig pa yin/

dpang gzugs la rdo rje 'chang gi bka' ma bcag nas myur tu gtong / 'das dang mar g.yas pa gri gug dgra srog gcod la gri gug bskor zhing 'phyar/ g.yon pa gdug pa'i khrag bkang gsol la g.yon pa bskor zhing thugs kar bsdu/ gang zhig dkon mchog nas myur du gtong / gnyis ga'i rol mo sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis sogs yin kyang gong gi bcom len dang gsum po de med pas cung mi 'dra bdun brdung gsum che gcig yin/ 'chams tshul 'dra/ dpal ldan mgon po nas 'dur/ phyag g.yas tshig rol la lag gnyis g.yas mdun la bskor gcig la g.yas g.yon la g.yab/ gnyis la g.yas 'phyar/ g.yon lte thad gyen bstan/ gsum la lag gnyis g.yas su brkyang / dgu brdung la yang pad gcig la g.yon g.yab/ gnyis la g.yas 'phyar/ g.yon lte thad gyen bstan/ gsum la mdun du 'jog pa 'og ma kun la rigs 'gre/ g.yon pa thod pa nas 'dur/ 'jig rten gsum po la tshig rol dgu rdung / shin tu nas 'dur/ di na me ke la tshig rol dgu rdung / ma ra nas 'dur/ gsung rgyun la yod pa'i ma g.yel da lta nyid du mdzod/ bcol pa'i phrin las bsnan pa la tshig rol dgu rdung / rnam shes spor dmigs gri gug gyen bstan liṅga 'og ma rnams kyi rkang rtse nas bzung gyen stabs su gtub pa dang / dkar dung drag dung / dung chen la til/ phal cher gtubs tshar ba dang drag dung gong bzhin/ zhwa phud gri gug ling snod sbrags ma thog nas sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis la dbus su bteg gsum bzhi gcig gnyis la g.yas su bteg gsum bzhi gcig gnyis la g.yon du bteg gsum bzhi gcig zhes mdun du bzhag hūm̐ phyi nang sogs wā ya wā ya la dbus su bteg hūm̐ dang ba'i sogs wā ya wā ya la g.yas bteg hūm̐ sha khrag sogs wā ya wā ya la g.yon du bteg hūm̐ lha tshogs sogs wā ya wā ya gcig gi gnyis sogs dbus/ g.yas g.yon dbus rnams la byed tshul gong bzhin/ chems brdung la ling ro mchod dpon la sprad/

sgang dung rang rdo rje thugs ka dril bu rgyun chags/ bzlog dkyil mdun gyi gtor theb lnga tshar gcig tu blug mtheb skyu sha bcas re yang bcug pa/ khrag chang gis sbyangs tshar ba dang gsum brdeg len can byas nas rnga rol bzhag oṃ la lag g.yas/ āḥl g.yon/ hūm̐ la gnyis ga ho la bya khyung phyag rgya bstan pa tshar gsum/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye'i mthar se gol gtogs pa'i shā sa nas tshar lnga/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ye lha mo la zhal gyi gtor sngags a li ru ru 'thud pa/ oṃ ma hā kā la yak+ṣa muts+tsha sogs 'bul sngags tshar re/ mtshan sngags gcig sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod phyag rgya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ la mtheb srin gyis nang mchod/ rdo rje thugs ka dril bu rgyun chags/ rnga rol sgang dung sbub la dpal rdo rje sogs phrin bcol tshar ro/ /chem brdung rdzogs nas sbraṃ gcig gnyis zhes dril gsil dung rnga rol 'jog pa/ tshar bcu gsum la ling ro mtheb kyu 'bul snod gtor teb lnga tshar gnyis res mos dang g.yas gnyis gar 'bul mi re dgos/ bcu gnyis pa'i lnga tshar phul tshar nas bshal chu gtor teb gcig nas gcig la blug tshar rim phyir la gtor teb bsdud/ bcu gsum pa yang rigs 'gre/ bcu gsum pa'i chem brdung mthar sum brdeg len can byas nas rdor dril rnga rol bzhag bdud rtsi lnga mchod/ khrag gi mchod yon nas sha rus zhal zas bar gdangs la thal sbyar/ mtshan sngags la pad skor/ rang sngags la so so'i phyag rgya/ swāhā la se gol phyir gtogs nang gtogs yin/ de nas bcom brdungs bcom rol sum brdeg len can gyi bcom dung rjes ma'i chems brdung sgang dung la rkang gling 'bud/ dril bu dam tshig dbyangs rol rdzogs nas chems brdung sgang dung rkang gling gi g.yab dar gsum brdeg len can/ de phyir 'dur gdangs gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa re dang / rjes mar chems brdungs sgang dung gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa byas nas/

nag po mchod rten gyi rdo rje brag chen la dbyangs sam tshig rol lam shur ma gang gtong yang kye bos rdzogs bar/ de nas spyan 'dren med pa'i sgos bskang ngam thugs dam ma mgo dbyangs/ shur ma sogs yin kyang re zhig mkho byed med/ gzhung rang na rgyas par bdud rtsi lnga mchod/ bsdu na mgon po 'khor dang sogs nas sgrub cing rtag tu khyed mchod do bar byas nas/ bstod pa gtor rdzong rdo rje'i glu bkra shis smon lam grub nas kye bos sogs gsung pa zhal gcig gi lugs yin/ cho ga lhag chad med phyin rgyas bsdus rang skabs su gang bab yin pa gsang sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod nas bzung gtor bzlog bar rgyud dang rgya bod gzhung kun mthun pas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gnas yo byin rlabs gzhung bzhin/ brag rdzong ma gtor bsngo chen mo'i kye rdor bde mchog bzlog dkyil sgrub pa/ bran bdud bcas sngags grangs gzhung mchan bzhin/ gtor bsngo chen mo'i bzlas mjug gi phyi mchod nang mchod phrin bcol bshags pa gcig gam gsum bskang rdzas byin brlabs nas bzung 'bul sngags mchod phrin rdzogs bar bskang rdzas byin brlab nas bzung 'bul sngags mchod phrin rdzogs bar bskang gsar sor bzhag bsgral mchod skor gzhung mchan nang bzhin/ 'bul tshan bcu gsum byas nas bstan srung rgya mtsho mchod sogs/ bskang gsar bzlog pa rdzogs bar/ drag bskul yongs rdzogs sam yang na dus gsum rgyal ba gcig pu/ sngags dbyangs bstod pa rngam rab gang rung gtor rdzong gtor glu/ bkra shis smon lam/ rjes chog la dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang nag po chen por gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gur gyi sogsྎ /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa sogs/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas man chad rgyun bskang bzhin yin pas 'di tsam gyis kyang chog pa lhag chad med pa'i don tshang /

༈ /sa skya rang na ni mdos chung la dus gtor chen mo bsres nas/ de wī ko ṭa dang 'jam rdor chos nyid ma rnams mi dgos/ nyer drug la nag po mchod rten las bskang gsar med pa'i nyer drug dus gtor yin/ bka' bsgo'i 'dod pa'i don rnams myur du sgrub/ bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod kyi rjes su rnga phyir bsgyur dang bcas sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum dgu brdung gcig gcig gnyis gsum zhes bzhag nas/ hūm̐ bse mgon sogs tshig rol dgu rdung / hūm̐ dus gsum sogs rol mo 'dra/ bh+yoḥgason cig sogs rol mo/ hūm̐ chos skyong sogs rol mo/ hūm̐ dam can sogs rol mo byas nas nyer bdun la rnga shon/ gzhan chems brdung drag dung chems/ gsum brdeg len can dus gtor so so'i bstod pa gang yin/ nyer dgu kye bos dang mon bu pu tra bzhag rkyen ngan rbod gtong med par mdzod la bzlog rol dgu brdung gcig bzlog pa gcig bshags pa rdzogs nas sngags dbyangs bstod pa phur srung mjug gsum brdeg len can gtor rdzong gtor glu sogs gong bzhin byas nas sa srib sogs la tshogs dung grub pa dang bskul rnams nas 'phen zin/ yar 'byor srid zhi dpal 'byor mjug chog 'jigs rung sogs/ bkra shis 'bru 'thor bcas/ zor las pa'i bshad pa bsang re dkar chags/ phur chung gtor bsngo/ gnam gang dus gtor gtor 'bul/ bstan skyong med pa rnams yin pas bse mgon drag bskul 'phar ba ma gtogs gzhung mchan dang phyag deb nang bzhin la mthong brgyud thos brgyud la dag snang don 'dzin byas nas sgrigs rgyugs sngags 'chang chen po mnyes 'gro 'phar ma'i rigs thams cad la'ang gzhan gong bzhin las/ bskang ba bstod pa rgyas bsdus sna tshogs yin/ snga mo nyer bdun la bzlas grangs nyung ba zhig yod/ nyer brgyad/ nyer dgu gnyis nam langs pa srub bar mdzad/ 'on kyang bskang gsar la sbyar zhing spyan 'dren rgyas pa rnams bzhag pa dang /

drag bskul rgyas pa rnams bzhag la 'di mi mdzad/ gang ltar da lam bskang gsar la/ sbyar zhing drag bskul rgyas pa rnams med pa 'di ltar na 'phen nyin gtor rdzong rdor glu bkra shis smon lam rdzogs nas nyin snga phyi'i mtshan snga phyi gang rung la 'phen chog pas gzhung gi dngos zin yin pas zor las pas phod ka rdor gang yul phyogs de na zor pang khro zhal ma gyon srol yod na de rus pa'i mgul rgyan se ral kha ral tshab/ zhwa nag zhwa dar zur 'dogs zhes snga mo zur la yod 'dug dus phyis rgyab tu btang bas spom du song / zhwa nag ni srid pa rtse zhwa zhes sngags rnying ma dang / 'di'i man ngag mthun par rgyu phyi nang nag mkhregs po las grub pa'i ri rab zur drug rtse snyung la mtha' skor rgyab pa'i gshog steng dar gos chen nam/ bal tshon lnga gang rung gi thog ring rtse lnga zhes chos 'byung bsnol ma 'dra ba'i zur bzhi dang mdun la rtse gcig yod pa ri rab zur drug lta bu'i 'bor de'i mdun la 'byor na dngul gyi zla phyed/ gser gyi nyi ma/ ma 'byor na rgyu gang yang rung ba las grub pa'i zla phyed nyi ma'i gzugs rtse snyung la rnga nag gi phod las med kyang da lta grub mtha' phal mo che mthun par mdzes tshon mthong brgyud bse sogs la bcas pa 'di'i cha 'dra rung g.yas gri gug dar nag can/ g.yon bhan+dha skra bcas khyer nas/ rol sil rkang gling g.yab dar can gyi dkyil du bsdad/ de'i mdun du rnga ma gang yod sgril nas rol sil rkang gling g.yab dar bcas hod kyis blangs pa'i chems brdung sbraṃ gcig go gnyis go gsum la lag mgo gul tsam sbraṃ la mdun du mnan/ gcig la lag pa rol stabs rkang g.yas g.yas su bkyal/ gnyis byas la rkang g.yas mdun du phab lag pad kor/ gcig la rkang g.yas g.yas thad du bzhag la pad kor 'phro/ gnyis byas la rkang g.yon g.yon thad du bzhag lag pad kor 'phro/ gcig la rkang gnyis so sor bzhag

gri gug bhan+dha mdun la g.yab/ kye bos nas dam ma g.yel bar rang dbyangs/ sa skya rang du 'di skabs dam rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu ster/ sbraṃ la mdun du mnan/ sbraṃ la len pa rol stabs/ rkang g.yas rgyab tu bkyal/ gzhan gong bzhin la gnyis zhes pa gri gug bhan+dha mdun la g.yab/ yang bskur ro nas gnas 'dir byon bar dbyangs rol 'chams bcas gong bzhin/ sngon tshe nas shur ma mdzod cig bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod bar/ hūm̐ ngo dpal lā ldan ne sogs bka' bsgo'i sngon gyi dam tshig bzhin bar/ 'on kyang gsung rgyun la ni/ de ye ba yi sngon no kyi yi dam 'am ma tshig gi rang nga ni zhes rol mo len/ yang dang dang por ro sogs dbyangs du bā ta/ rnal la 'byor ro bdag gag bskul lo rang nga gyis/ sbraṃ la mdun du sgur/ sbraṃ la rkang g.yas rgyab tu spos/ lag pa rol stabs/ gcig la g.yas gnyis la mdun/ gsum byas la g.yon lag stabs pad kor/ gcig la lag stabs pad kor 'phro nas rkang g.yas g.yas su spel/ gnyis la lag stabs de ga'i ngang nas rkang g.yon g.yon bzhag gsum la rkang gnyis mnyam/ gri gug bhan+dha g.yab/ /brtse gdung nas shur/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod la rol mo blang sbraṃ la mdun du sgur/ sbraṃ la lag pa gzings/ gcig la lag g.yas g.yon du g.yab/ gnyis la lag g.yas 'phyar/ g.yon lte ba'i thad kar gyen bstan/ gsum la lag gnyis g.yas su shad brkyang / gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga rnams la lag rol stabs/ rkang g.yas mdun la spo zhing bskor ba'i mthar rgyab tu slebs pa dang / lag pad kor rkang g.yas rgyab tu phab drug ces bya/ mdun la lag stabs de ga'i ngang nas rkang g.yas glo bur mdun du bkyal/ brgyad la rkang gnyis mnyam/ lag gnyis thugs kar mnyam/ dgu la rkang stabs de ga'i ngang nas lag gnyis mdun du mnan/ sbraṃ la mdun du sgur/ gcig la rkang lag g.yas g.yon la g.yab/ gnyis la g.yas 'phyar sogs gong dang 'dra/ dgu la mdun du mnan nas we la dgye/

gcig gnyis gsum mo bzhi zhes mdung dar gser skyems dam phor khur mi zor gtor rnga rol rkang gling g.yab dar bcas kyi rjes su zor las pa'i rgyab nas brdab phod yod na 'khur mi dang / dge 'dun mdo sgrub gtor rgyab yod na dang / me mda' sogs rgyab dmag yod na g.yas ru g.yon ru dbus ru dmag dpon mkhas pas mgo byas nas me mda' sgra sogs dang / ki dang bso dang / ho ho sogs 'jigs rung gi sgra dgos te/ rngam 'jigs spros pa shin tu che bar gnang zhes zur za'i tshig de la phog pa zhig bya/ don la'ang de ltar dgos pa rtsod pa po rang nyid kyang bzhed/ phyi rol ji ltar rigs par zor gtor bran bdud pu tra drug cu pa rnams bsgrigs thun gtor phud chang bcas kyang rdo stegs lta bur bshams/ rnga rol rkang gling sa gral 'grigs rjes zor las pas g.yas gri gug dang bcas pa'i sked gzer/ g.yon bhan+dha pus mo g.yon steng g.yab/ rkang g.yon rtse mdun la cung zad spe ba dang bcas pas gcig go gnyis gsum mo bzhi zer ba len gsum tsam rjes gcig go la lag g.yon rkang g.yon phyir g.yug gnyis la rkang g.yas dang lag gnyis bteg gsum la rkang g.yas lag g.yas mdun phab kyis mchongs pa/ bzhi la lag g.yas mdun la bskor/ rkang g.yon rgyab nas drud/ yang gcig la lag g.yas rkang g.yas phyir byug pa sogs res mos kyis rol gral du slebs pa dang sbraṃ la mdun du sgur/ sbraṃ la dgye/ lag pa gnyis rol stabs/ gcig gnyis gsum byas rnams la rkang g.yas g.yas mdun g.yon rnams su spel/ gcig la rkang g.yas g.yas su bkyal lag pa pad kor gnyis la rkang g.yon g.yon du bzhag gsum byas la lag stabs de ga'i ngang nas rkang gnyis mdun du bzhag gcig la gri gug bhan+dha g.yab/ mon bu pu tra'i dbyangs kyi dzar la pad kor dang g.yab/ sbraṃ la sgur/ sbraṃ la gyed gcig gnyis gsum/ gcig gnyis gsum rnams gong bzhin la gsum la g.yab/

dbyangs rol rjes mar yang 'dra/ mon bu bha ṭa nas shur/ las rnams mdzod bar/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan mgon po sogs/ snga mo dpal ldan gru 'dzin ma'i dbyangs rang yin zhing da lta'ang 'chugs med/ mgyogs chos pas ngo mi shes pa ltar gyur kyang don la ni dbyangs rol cung zad kyang ma 'chugs par bzhugs 'dug de'i dzar la gri gug bhan+dha g.yab/ gsum brdeg la 'chams tshul mon bu pu tra'i skabs bzhin/ lcam dral nas shur/ dpon slob bsrung zhing la zor las pa rol sil rkang gling kha phyir blta/ bla mas bcol pa'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod la rol mo blang / gsum brdeg la 'chams tshul 'dra/ gcig byas gnyis byas gsum byas zhes then rkang la ci yang mi byed/ chems brdung la slob dpon bsrung zhing gi skabs ltar phyir bltas la gtor ma bsngos/ chems brdung gnyis pa phrin bcol gang shes/ rdzogs nas phyir bltas rnams nang ltas su bsgyur sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum dgu brdung gcig gnyis gsum rnams la kye bos mjug gi 'chams tshul/ sems can dang mgon po 'khor bcas zer rgyu yin kyang / ngag dang dpe phal cher la gson cig mgon po zhes 'byung / gang yin la tshig rol dgu brdung sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum zhes dgu brdung gnyis pa'i 'chams tshul gyi bos dgu brdung gnyis pa bzhin/ hūm̐/ lha chen dpal 'bar/ do nub bzlog bsgyur dang / ma mo'i khrag zor dang / nad rigs bzhi brgya dang / deng sang phal cher nad rigs bzhi brgya zer yang rims la bzhi brgya'i bshad pa med/ nad rigs la bzhi brgya'i rkang grangs nges can yin/ bud med dmod zor dang / thams cad rbod gtong dang / rtag tu bsrung skyobs rnams la tshig rol dgu brdung re byas nas rjes ma'i rjes su dgu we gcig sogs gong bzhin phyin la dzaṃ med pa'i bzhi 'gros kyi bral du slebs nas gsum brdeg len can 'chams tshul gong bzhin/ hūm̐ dus gsum rgyal ba gang thugs dbyangs rol dzar la pad kor dang g.yab/

gsum brdeg 'chams tshul 'dra/ lcam dral nas shur/ myur du la tshig rol dgu rdung rjes dgu we sogs 'gre/ brdeg par slebs pa dang dzaṃ med bzhi 'gros ci rigs rol gral du ma yong bar rol mo ba'i rgyab tu lag g.yas phud phor skyems bcas bzung / g.yon g.yas pa'i gzhu shub dkur bstan gsum brdeg len can la 'chams mi dgos/ rnga rol bzhag nas bdud rtsi byin rlabs kyai rdor bzhin rol mo hod kyis blangs/ bcom rol gyi chung gsum la rkang g.yas rtse sa la nem nem gsum byas pas shugs rang gi mdun gsig 'byung / sbraṃ la rkang g.yas rgyab tu spos/ gcig la lag gnyis la mdun/ gsum la g.yon rnams su spos/ byas zhes par rkang g.yas bteg tsam/ gcig la rkang g.yas su bkyal/ gsum byas la g.yas g.yas rang du phab/ gcig la g.yon rting pa btsugs/ dpal lā g.yas rgyab tu gcus/ lhan ne la rkang g.yas mdun du bskor/ nel tsam byed/ rtsa la rkang g.yas g.yon du spos/ lag g.yas bteg 'a wa la rkang g.yas lag g.yas su gzhol/ brgyud la rkang g.yon g.yas su bkyal/ lag g.yas 'phyar ba sogs re mos dbyangs la rdzogs bar yin/ 'on kyang / bsam ma don 'grub 'ub par rā 'i'i ya ya bar 'chams/ mdzad we du 'u ya wā ya gsol zhes pa'i bar mi 'chams par lag mgo 'phrug tsam byed la zhes rol mo len 'chams tshul gong bzhin gcig ces pa dang phud phor skyems gtor/ skyems gsang blug rgyal ba'i zhes pa nas sde tshan re re la tshig rol dgu brdung 'chams tshul 'thor lugs rnams 'dra/ rjes mar chems brdung la gtor nas yang blugs la nam mkhar 'thor/ yang blugs la bar snang la 'thor/ yang blugs la sa gzhir 'thor/ yang blugs la rang gi mtheb srin g.yon pas myang nas sa la 'bo ba dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha zer/ de nas gri gug bhan+dha thogs la rang 'gros kyis gral du 'ong nas sbraṃ sbraṃ sogs dgu brdung 'chams tshul 'dra/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ

nga ni sogs dpang gzugs shur ma tshig rol dgu brdung 'chams tshul 'dra/ de nas slob dpon kha gtor ma 'phang phyogs la bltas gri gug so phyir bstan thugs kar bzung / hūm̐ bdag lus sogs zor lam dbye ba shur ma tshig rol dgu brdung 'chams tshul 'dra/ chems brdung la gri gug zor lam dbye tshul sngags bcas slob dpon nang du kha bsgyur ba sbraṃ la lus sgur/ sbraṃ la dgye zhing lag gnyis bteg pad kor nang nas rkang g.yas gcig la g.yas/ gnyis byas la mdun pad kor 'phro nas gcig la rkang g.yon g.yon du bteg tsam bya la gnyis byas la de bar bzhag gcig la rkang gnyis mdun du mnyam/ gri gug bhan+dha g.yas/ dpal la 'bar wā ya ma wā ha wā ya kā 'a 'a wā kā yā wā ya dang / zhes sogs kyi rol mo dzar ni de'i tshig re la rol mo byed dgos pas/ de'i tshul ni/ 'a'i zhes pa'i dus rnga phyir rdung / de'i ngang nas 'og tu cung zhig mnan cing rol mo blangs la/ ya'i zhes pa'i dus steng gi nam mkhar bteg steng nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni zhes pa ste tshig dang po rnams la rol mo che ba dang / tshig lhad rnams la cung chung tsam ma gtogs gzhan rol mo dal brel snyoms shing rngam brjid dang ldan pa bya'o/ /'di'i rol mo rnams yongs su bsdoms pa'i grangs ni bcu drug 'byung zhing / 'i zhes pa'i dus rnga phab nas rol mo brdeg go /de bzhin du g.yon du mnan nas g.yas pa dang / g.yas su mnan nas g.yon/ mdun du mnan nas rgyab/ rgyab tu mnan nas mdun byed pa ma gtogs rol mo'i kha grangs ni/ gong bzhin g.yas shig sogs kyi dus kyang 'chams stabs pho nya'i 'dur 'chams yin pas bab gsig rngam brjid dang ldan nges byed pa ma gtogs lhu med kyi tsha reg mi bya'o/ /'di thams cad la rol mo ni nyis brdeg len bcas kho na yin pas rjes ma'i mjug tu gnyis zhes pa la mnan nas cung che ba gcig gi rjes su bzhi brdung gsum byed dgos pas de'i bteg tshul ni/

gcig la shin tu che ba/ gnyis dang gsum la chung ba/ bzhi la che ba ste de 'dra ba gsum gyi mjug tu chems rdung byas la bran bdud kyi gtor ma bteg pu tra'i gtor ma yang chems brdung de 'dra'i ngang nas bteg de nas gtso gtor blangs la rol mo len che ba gcig gi rjes su bzhi brdung gsum gong bzhin byas pa'i mthar chems brdung bya zhing gtso gtor 'phang rjes rol mo bzhi brdeg byed ces 'jam dbyangs dbang po'i rol yig las gsungs/ 'chams ni steng gi dzar la gri gug bhan+dha rol stabs su bzung nas rting phyir g.yas g.yon re mos kyis g.yas gcus g.yon gcus gnyis brdeg len can sbraṃ zhes mdun du mnan/ sbraṃ la rkang g.yas rgyab tu bkyal/ lag pa rol stabs gcig la g.yas gnyis byas la mdun/ gcig gnyis byas gcig rnams gong bzhin/ g.yas g.yon rgyab dzar rnams la lag pa rol stabs/ rkang pa g.yas g.yon re mos su bteg nas gral de gar 'gro/ mdun la gral nas phyir myur stabs 'chams tshul de gas phyin te zor drung slebs pa dang / gri gug bhan+dha gzhan gyis bzung phod pa rjes zhes da lta gzhu shubs gnyis rgyab tu thung ngur sdud pa zhig 'dug drag las kyi gzhung rnams su thu ba g.yas brdzes g.yon pa brjes bya nas zhes pa ltar na de ltar dgos rgyu yin 'dra/ yang da lta'i 'di'i 'thus/ bran bdun gtor ma bzung / de'i dpal 'bar sbar gnyis brdeg len can la gtor ma bzung bzhin du 'chams stabs gong bzhin/ sbraṃ gcig bteg gnyis la gtor ma dang / rkang pa g.yon g.yas su bteg gsum mam bzhi la mdun nas bskor gcig gnyis la gtor rkang g.yas g.yon du bteg gsum mo bzhi la mdun du bskor/ gcig bteg gnyis la gtor rkang g.yon dkyil du bteg gsum mo bzhi la rkang gnyis rang sar bzhag gtor ma phrag pa g.yas su 'phyar nas sngags dmod mthar mdun gyi 'brub khung du rtse thur bstan kha phub tu shugs bskyed la bstab/

pu tra'i gtor ma dpal 'bar bar phyag g.yas su 'phyar rdeb 'dra/ gtso gtor la dzaṃ gong bzhin phrag g.yas 'phyar/ sngags dmod skabs dpal 'bar gang yod rim gyis sbar bas me dpung chen po de gong bzhin brdab/ brdab phod ces bla ma gong ma'i gsol phod gtor slang la brdab pa la zer/ chos gos snam sbyar sogs bla gos dang / sham thabs sogs thang gos dang skyes pho mo'i gos 'go mjug bzlog pa dang / gcan gzan pags pa phod ka'i thu sne sogs gang brdab kyang chog de nas rang gi g.yon la kha bsgyur 'phang par rgyab bstan/ rnga rol bzhag rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs/ nang du slebs nas srid zhi dpal 'byor mjug chog bkra shis 'bru char/ 'jigs rung sogs yin/ gal te sang gtor 'bul med na thog khar phyin nas gtor 'bul gyi mjug gtor phul la nang du slebs nas mjug chog gong bzhin yin/ gzhung gi dngos bstan dgra bgegs gnad gcod bcas kyi dgongs pa tshom bur lhar bskyed zor gtor 'bul rgyu yin pas tshom bu la gshegs gsol dgos/ kho bo'i lhan thabs na tshom gtor gnyis lhar bskyed pa gur mgon khro bcu'i rjes gnang bzhin byas nas tshom bu bsdus tshar lha nam mkha' na bzhugs pa rang ngam rten mgon khang dang dgon par spyi thabs su bzhugs dgos la bstim/ gzhan gur lha brgyad zhal gtso 'khor rnams rten yod tshad la bstim mi nyan pas rang gi snying gar bsdu ba la man ngag yod kyang chos de ma go ba rnams kyis rang bzhin bsdu ba yin no/ /zhes sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis a li chos rjer bla ma kun dga' dpal bzang 'gro ba'i re skong dang a li chos rje rang gi'ang 'dod sbyar bzhin bris/ kho bo tshar chen rin po ches rjes su bzung zhing mi phyed dad pa yod pas gnas lugs zhus pa la gshin rjes yi ge bris mi yong // // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ kha shog mi gsal kyang drug cu ma'i skor dogs dris zhig 'dra/
